reason: I use AI at work, fine, but I'm not letting a cartoon pet decide where my retirement money goes or pay for things on my behalf. And on top of that I'm not paying a monthly subscription to invest when my broker app already lets me buy index funds for free.
objection: An AI moving real money by itself, even 'within limits', is the part I don't trust. If it makes a bad call, a downloadable record of what it did doesn't get my money back.
would_change_my_mind: Years of a real track record with real money, through an established licensed broker I already know, where the AI only suggests and never acts without my tap.
